mapper.sql: id, diary_id, open_id, editor_content, create_time, log_time, log_week, log_lunar, address, image_urls, db_create_time, db_update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary ( diary_id, open_id, editor_content, create_time, log_time, log_week, log_lunar, address, image_urls, db_create_time, db_update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{diaryId}, #{openId}, #{editorContent}, #{createTime}, #{logTime}, #{logWeek}, #{logLunar}, #{address}, #{imageUrls}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM diary WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM diary WHERE diary_id = #{diaryId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM diary WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY log_time DESC, db_create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary WHERE open_id = #{openId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE diary
editor_content = #{editorContent}, create_time = #{createTime}, log_time = #{logTime}, log_week = #{logWeek}, log_lunar = #{logLunar}, address = #{address}, image_urls = #{imageUrls}, db_update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
